form.label: Review readiness — Universal Forwarder feeds
form.description: Compare indexed host/feed identities with the explicitly configured expected inventory. Presence is not collection continuity or control acceptance.

html.p: Configure the aulx_source macro and aulx_expected_sources lookup for your approved scope. An empty inventory means coverage is unknown, not complete. Use exact indexed host/index/sourcetype values; unexpected aliases stay visible. Expected hosts with no records remain listed. Feed coverage does not prove every application or required event is covered.

The weekly evidence tool is supplied in bin/aulx_review.py. It exports fixed-window normalized events, source records, feed coverage, case summaries, search/version metadata, checksums, and an unsigned review worksheet. No schedule, forwarding, audit policy, retention, user or role changes are installed.

search.query: | inputlookup aulx_expected_sources | where enabled="1" | stats count AS configured_feeds

table.title: Expected and observed feeds — review every gap

html.p: No records can mean inactivity, a collection problem, an incorrect scope, retention loss, or an event-time parsing problem. Check source logs and forwarder inputs before deciding. Review search warnings: a failed or truncated search cannot establish absence. For quiet event sources, choose a justified threshold or use separately collected health telemetry; do not manufacture heartbeat audit events.

Event fields, source-reported usernames and content checks are evidence aids. Human attribution, timestamp correctness, integrity, retention and applicability need separate validation. The 57-case catalog is a starter profile, not a universal mandate. The latest-five dashboard samples are not a complete review export.
